append.detail: 2026-10-27 (SCAN-1129 thread): second slice. New kit helpers chipClasses (components/ui/chip.tsx, the kit .chip/.chip.on) and choiceTileClasses (components/ui/choice-tile.tsx). Selected-state toggles (creator tabs, Near me, mobile editor tabs, billing toggle, visibility, practice builder, spaces toolbar), selectable tiles (event draft, RSVP, on-air, connection prefs, email opt-in, member viewer) and soft/ghost/state-driven actions (publish buttons, claim and join buttons, store, complete) moved onto the kit. Left: admin files, global-error, the Airwaves play button, circle-location-search (its probe mocks module deps), and quirk hits where the ratchet's proximity window catches a comment. Selected-state residual pass: donation/tip amount presets and nearby broadcast type use chipClasses; mobile field radio uses choiceTileClasses with 44px minimum and existing radio semantics. Broadcast type and tip amount now expose existing selection through aria-pressed. Callbacks, pricing/amount parsing, disabled gates and checked predicates unchanged by AST control excluding style/helper imports and intended pressed-state additions. No payment or broadcast executed; aggregate/rendered acceptance remains open.
